title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct expression for the surface charge density induced on the sphere.

title: Electric Field Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly transforms the electric field from the laboratory frame to the rest frame of the sphere.

title: Magnetic Field Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student accurately transforms the magnetic field from the laboratory frame to the rest frame of the sphere.

title: Boundary Condition Application
description: Important Criteria: The student applies the boundary condition for the electric displacement field correctly to find the surface charge density.

title: Neglecting Higher Order Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The student appropriately neglects higher order terms in the approximation of gamma.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to maintain the correct signs when calculating the surface charge density.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student does not check for consistency of units in the final expression for surface charge density.
